shared_elements: low-relief carving worked into a large vertical stone monument
plain undecorated stone ground surrounding the motifs
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings of raised, curving linear motifs left standing proud of an otherwise blank stone surface on a large upright monument, which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise A is a flat slab bearing a single recognisable elongated animal in profile with angled limbs, while B is a fully three-dimensional carved figure whose surface bears symmetrical abstract discs, rings and arcs in a much darker, coarser stone.
